name: hidevalues
description: Hides high-entropy tokens and e-mail addresses in Bash results until hovered

min_length.title: Minimum token length
min_length.description: A run of token characters shorter than this is never hidden.

min_entropy.title: Minimum entropy (bits per character)
min_entropy.description: A token below this Shannon entropy is never hidden; 4.0 is the case study's threshold.

emails.title: Hide e-mail addresses
emails.description: Also hide anything shaped like an e-mail address.

hide_color.title: Block colour
hide_color.description: Hidden text is drawn in this colour on this colour.

reveal_color.title: Reveal colour
reveal_color.description: The text colour while the pointer is over a hidden value.
